newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA STOCK MARKET STAGNANT, RABSI UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA STOCK MARKET STAGNANT, RABSI UNCHANGED.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Friday's 41.14 points as the local stock market was stagnant for a third day in a row, brokers said.

Hebros bank shares were offered at 880 levs against par of 1,000 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there were no bidders. Central Cooperative Bank shares were also offered there at par of 1,000 but no bids were received.

United Bulgarian Bank shares were bid at 500 levs on the BSE, still below par of 1,000, traders said. Varna Grand Hotel stocks were also bid at 85 levs against par of 100 but there were no shares on offer.
One seven-day repo deal in treasury paper worth of 752,000 levs was struck on the Sofia Stock Exchange, yielding 1.90 percent until repurchase.
